description: Audit an HTTP response you captured against a contract you declare: expected status or status class, required and forbidden headers, header value rules, and a body schema. Header names compare case-insensitively. You supply the response, so this works against an API behind authentication or on a private network. Pay 120000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

body_schema.description: A JSON Schema using the supported keyword subset: type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, patternProperties, items, prefixItems, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, minLength, maxLength, pattern, format, minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, exclusiveMaximum, multipleOf, minProperties, maxProperties, nullable, allOf, anyOf, oneOf, not, $ref, $defs, definitions, title, description, default, examples, example, deprecated, readOnly, writeOnly. Patterns use a non-backtracking subset with no groups or alternation. $ref resolves inside the document only; a remote reference is refused rather than fetched. A keyword outside the subset is reported in not_examined rather than treated as satisfied.

expected_status.description: An exact code, a class such as 2xx, or an array of either.

forbidden_headers.description: Headers that must not be present, such as one that leaks a server implementation.

header_values.description: Map of header name to an exact string, or to an object with starts_with.

body.description: Any JSON value you supply. Nothing is fetched, so this works on payloads nothing could reach.

headers.description: Observed response headers, at most 100. Names are matched case-insensitively.

name: api_response_contract_audit

checked.description: Which parts of the contract were actually exercised, so a thin contract cannot read as a thorough audit.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of the input was not analysed, which is a different problem from input that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when every declared check ran and passed. A body supplied without a body_schema leaves the audit incomplete.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing below is bounded.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the exact location.

findings_by_code.description: Counts per code, for triage without reading the list.

not_examined.description: Named reasons anything was left unexamined: a bound reached, an unsupported keyword, an unresolvable reference, or findings beyond the listing cap.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: API Response Contract Audit
